7.
(1) It shall be lawful for the Corporation, from time to
time, at any general meeting and by a majority of not less
than two thirds of the members present and voting, to make
rules, not inconsistent with the provisions of this Act, and
any  other  written  law  for  all  or  any  of  the  following
matters :—

(a)
classification of membership, fees payable by each
class  of  member,  their  admission,  withdrawal,
expulsion or resignation ;

(b)
election of the Council, or vocation of, or removal
from office as office bearers and powers, duties and
conduct of the Council ;

(c)
appointment, powers, duties, functions and conduct
of the various officers, agents and servants of the
Corporation  ;

(d)
the  procedure

meetings ;

(e)
